extracted.name: Creamy Mushrooms
extracted.description: Mushrooms are sauteed in butter, then simmered with milk, flour and soy sauce, creating a creamy gravy. Serve over warm biscuits, rice or pasta.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Saute mushrooms until tender. Stir in flour, milk and soy sauce; cook, stirring, until thickened. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
